summary_for_children: Al-Isra begins with the night journey to al-Masjid al-Aqsa and gives guidance: honour parents, be honest, and know that everything glorifies Allah.
world_title: The Night of Light and Guidance
environment_concept: A night journey of lamps from one sacred mosque to another, then a land where the night and day are signs and parents are honoured.
architecture_and_scenery: A path of lamps across a moonlit land, a domed mosque far off, a family courtyard, a market.

areas.name: Path of Lamps
areas.description: A path of lamps through the night; nothing of the journey is depicted.

areas.name: Two Signs
areas.description: Night and day shown as two signs.

areas.name: Courtyard of Parents
areas.description: A family courtyard; no people shown.

activities.name: Words for parents
activities.description: Choose gentle words to say to parents.

activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: The narrator reads 17:1 and explains only what the Quran states about the journey.
